AddDeviceIn.description:
Password is `SecretStr` so an accidental `repr()` anywhere, including
a structlog kwarg, renders `**********` instead of the plaintext.
AddDeviceIn.title: AddDeviceIn

AlertRules.description:
What to alert on. Seeded from `[alerts.rules]` and editable from the
dashboard, unless a `REOVAULT_ALERTS__RULES__*` env var pins it (same
scheme as retention).
AlertRules.title: AlertRules

DeviceSettingsIn.description:
The editable part of a camera's `[[devices]]` entry. Alias and channel
are its identity (reolink-cli's and the database's), so not editable.
DeviceSettingsIn.title: DeviceSettingsIn

DeviceSummaryOut.description: The navbar device switcher's row: cheap, no camera calls.
DeviceSummaryOut.title: DeviceSummaryOut

SdBarOut.description: GiB, all on the camera's own binary scale (see `sd_bar`).
SdBarOut.title: SdBarOut

post.description:
Cooperative: the Archiver checks the flag between recordings, so a
fetch or encrypt in flight finishes or fails on its own rather than
being torn down mid-write. The run then closes out as `aborted`.

schema.title: Response Send Test Api V1 Alerts Test Post

put.description:
Generic edit for the sections without a dedicated form. Only fields
the view marks editable are accepted: never an env-set or infrastructure
one, and never a nested table.

get.description:
`date_` defaults to the camera's own local today, so the dashboard
can open Footage without first knowing the camera's timezone.

schema.title: Response Discover Api V1 Devices Discover Post
Response List Enabled Api V1 Devices Enabled Get

put.description:
Writes `enabled` on the camera's `[[devices]]` entry; the config
listener then adds it to or removes it from the fleet and scheduler.

post.description:
Revokes every session server-side by bumping the epoch, not just this
browser's cookie: a copied cookie stops working too.

Re-queues every failed or quarantined recording of this camera for
the next run, the bulk form of `POST /recordings/{id}/retry`.

Makes a failed recording eligible for the next run's pickup; it is
not re-downloaded on the spot (see Repository.retry_recording).

put.description:
This camera's own `[devices.schedule]` in reovault.toml, or with
`inherit`, none (back to the default). The change is applied to the
scheduler by the config listener, like a hand edit of the file.

get.description: The global `[schedule]` every camera follows unless it has its own.
Clips per day per detection type, for the Health page's chart.

Public, for the Docker healthcheck, which only needs the status
code. `?verbose=1` adds gateway state, per-device coverage alarms
and database error text, so it needs a logged-in session: behind a
reverse-proxy hostname that detail would otherwise be public.
